args.summary: Completed and generated the OpenSeesPy spine beam model for a five-span (30 m each) precast continuous bridge with three C50 small box girders per span, 9 m deck, and the specified elastomeric/PTFE bearing layout. Section integration gave single-girder A=1.13893 m² and I=0.354917 m⁴; assembled girder properties are A=3.41679 m² and I=1.06475 m⁴. The model passed L1 topology, L2 code, and L3 mechanics checks. Modal analysis returned f1=3.513 Hz and impact factor μ=0.2063. Computed self-weight reactions are approximately [1052.6, 3014.3, 2595.8, 2595.8, 3014.3, 1052.6] kN; maximum lane moments are +6881.8 kN·m and −5093.9 kN·m.
